name: zvec-grep
description: Local hybrid (lexical + vector) workspace search over a zvec-grep index, with index management commands.

embedding.description: Embedding model for queries and for the indexes /zg-index builds; a command flag overrides it. Remote models need credentials in zg's own config (zg config provider set).

device.description: Device for local embedding models, forwarded to /zg-index as well.

mode.description: in-process loads the library inside the sidecar; external-daemon calls the zg CLI instead.

maxResults.description: Default item limit when the model does not pass limit.

ignoredGlobs.description: Path rules excluded from search, e.g. **/dist/**. Index scope is controlled by the zg-index command.

searchTimeoutMs.description: Sidecar-side budget for one search, kept inside the host's 120s tool limit.

notifyOnIndexComplete.description: Deliver a short message to the session when a background index job finishes.
